title: A Web-based Digital Distance Visual Acuity Test
brief_summary: Primary objective of this study is the development and validation of a web-based application for the examination of the distance visual acuity of normal- and low-vision patients.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients of our outpatient ophthalmology clinic
* Age between 18 to 75 years

Exclusion Criteria:

* Dyslexia
* Attention-deficiency
* Former diagnosis of mental and/or psychiatric diseases
* Inability to cooperate
study_population: Normal- and low-sighted participants aged 18 to 75 years.
